title: dalenia glandulosa
intro: Dalenia glandulosa, commonly known as Dalbergia glandulosa, is a tropical plant species that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It is a valuable plant used in traditional medicine, particularly in the treatment of various health conditions. The health benefits of Dalenia glandulosa include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in the management of fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds.
